reasons: Quantity differs: Datadog docker.net.bytes_rcvd is a per-container received-bytes total, but the candidate applies rate(), yielding bytes per second.
Unit differs: the candidate's result is B/s while the Datadog series is in bytes.
Grouping is lost: the Datadog query groups by docker_image, but the candidate has no by-clause, so avg collapses all containers into one series.
The correct grouping label in the observed dataset is container_image_name, which the candidate does not use.
Aggregation differs: Datadog averages per image group, while the candidate averages across every series.
Outcome 'translated' is appropriate because an exact translation exists (cumulative sum with avg by container_image_name), so blocking is not required.
